why: `g.level()` on an object of a class reads its property while `level` is one, and calls its method once `level` is a method of the class (MATLAB doc 'Method Invocation', 'Ordinary Methods'); turning the property into a method of the same name and back keeps every name the file defines, and each step must end where a fresh index ends (project rule; step 13).

edit.Gauge.m:
classdef Gauge
    methods
        function v = level(obj)
            v = 0;
        end
    end
end

classdef Gauge
    properties
        level = 0;
    end
end
